mapper.select: SELECT r.check_in_date AS `date`, COUNT(DISTINCT r.word_id) AS wordCount FROM study_record r WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.check_in_date IS NOT NULL AND r.check_in_date >= #{since} GROUP BY r.check_in_date ORDER BY r.check_in_date ASC

SELECT r.study_date AS `date`, SUM(CASE WHEN r.study_type = 'STUDY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS learnedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN r.study_type = 'REVIEW' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reviewCount, COALESCE(MAX(m.mistakeCount), 0) AS mistakeCount FROM ( SELECT user_id, study_date, study_type FROM study_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND study_date >= #{since} ) r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT user_id, CAST(create_time AS DATE) AS mistakeDate, COUNT(*) AS mistakeCount FROM mistake_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 GROUP BY user_id, CAST(create_time AS DATE) ) m ON m.user_id = r.user_id AND m.mistakeDate = r.study_date GROUP BY r.study_date ORDER BY r.study_date ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mistake_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND mastered = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mistake_entry WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT check_in_date) FROM study_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND check_in_date IS NOT NULL
SELECT w.word FROM mistake_entry m JOIN word w ON w.id = m.word_id AND w.deleted = 0 WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = 0 ORDER BY m.wrong_count DESC, m.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM word_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND learned = 1
SELECT book_id AS book_id, COUNT(*) AS learned_count FROM word_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND learned = 1 GROUP BY book_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM word_progress WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND learned = 1 AND next_review_date IS NOT NULL AND next_review_date <= #{date}
